title: How Bayer Crop Science built an agentic decision engine on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with AWS Unified Operations
summary: Bayer Crop Science built the Agentic Decision Engine (ADE), a multi-agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that lets breeders, analysts, and researchers ask natural language questions about their analytics platform. This post covers the ADE architecture, five design decisions
reason: Customer case study describing Bayer's Agentic Decision Engine architecture on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. No named model release, no new research artifact, no business event (financing/M&A/partnership), and no new open-source tool or framework launch.
